fullDescription:
KALORAMA is a refined high-contrast serif typeface designed for luxury branding, editorial compositions, and timeless visual identities.

It blends classical serif proportions with subtle modern detailing — creating a typeface that feels sophisticated, confident, and quietly powerful.

This is the kind of font that belongs on:
• Perfume bottles
• Fashion campaigns
• Luxury packaging
• Jewelry branding
• Boutique hotel identities
• Premium editorial layouts

Design Character
KALORAMA balances tradition and modern refinement. Its elegant vertical stress, sculpted serifs, and carefully controlled contrast give it a distinguished presence without feeling old-fashioned.

It feels:
• European
• Couture-inspired
• Editorial
• Romantic
• Sophisticated
• Calm but authoritative

The rhythm of the letters allows it to work beautifully in large headlines while maintaining clarity in refined subheadings.

Perfectly spaced for logos, titles, and premium print compositions.

Perfect For:
Luxury logos
Beauty & skincare brands
Fashion magazines
High-end packaging
Wedding branding
Restaurant identities
Architecture studios
Personal branding

Visual Identity Direction
Think:
Deep navy backgrounds
Gold foil stamping
Embossed letterpress
Velvet packaging
Museum catalog typography
Minimal European layouts

KALORAMA doesn’t compete for attention.
It commands it.
